title: Attain both powers with charged coherent exchange
statement: An explicit source-qubit/receiver-qutrit Hamiltonian transfers the arbitrary input on its logical-subspace flag.

evidence.range_scope: P1 actual recovery answer after its native-response delimiter,not the peer answer embedded in the issued prompt.

requires: One arbitrary unknown, initially UNENCODED source qubit S,possibly entangled with inaccessible R,starts in rho_RS tensor tau_apparatus. Apparatus resources may be large or internally entangled but are initially product with input/reference. Actual independent inaccessible noise lambda*D[Z_S],lambda>0,acts from the stipulated input time with Poisson Z jumps. All other source-apparatus dynamics have a dilation commuting with Z_S except charged H(t),||[H(t),Z_S]||<=omega(t),A(t)=integral_0^t omega(u)du. This includes every noncommuting source interaction,control and physically implemented measurement. Source is ultimately discarded;receiver may retain all accessible quantum outputs/records,wait,compute and postselect,including whole-output processing. Hidden noise record remains inaccessible.
provides: Receiver levels are|v>,|0>,|1>,initial|v>. V=sum_i |0>_S|i>_B <i|_S<v|_B andH(t)=g(t)(V+Vdagger),g>=0. This6-by-6 interaction has||H||=g and||[H,Z_S]||=2g. Both transition couplings are additional source access,not automatically supplied by a fixed measurement port.

With a=integral g,the noiseless map iscos(a)|psi>_S|v>_B-i sin(a)|0>_S|psi>_B. Accept the receiver logical subspace. With hidden jumps,the full successful CP map isM=p0*id+E,p0=exp(-lambda*T)*sin(a)^2,||E||diamond<=b=(1-exp(-lambda*T))*a^2. Comparing each hidden trajectory toH=0 bounds its accepted amplitude bya. For all input/reference states,p(rho)>=p0 andconditional HALF trace distance<=b/(p0+b)<=(exp(lambda*T)-1)*(a/sin(a))^2.

TakeT=eps/(2lambda),eps<=1/4,a<=1/2. Fixed peak pulseg=(Omega/2)sin^2(pi*t/T) hasareaOmega*eps/(8lambda),p0>=(Omega*eps/lambda)^2/128 andmax|gprime|=pi*Omega*lambda/eps. Fixed startup-slew pulseg=K*T/(2pi)*sin^2(pi*t/T) hasareaK*eps^2/(16pi*lambda^2),p0>=(K*eps^2/lambda^2)^2/4096 andmax|gprime|=K/2.

If the startup construction also has a peak limitOmega_max,it requiresK*eps/(2pi*lambda)<=Omega_max. Both powers are sharp only in the enlarged charged-interaction class and sufficiently small error regime. Failed attempts may consume the original input;these are not same-state retries or demonstrations of practical advantage over ordinary exchange.

Input must be arbitrary and unencoded at the stipulated start;prior encoding changes the task. Known-state preparation,fresh-copy distillation,protected subspaces and task-specific measurements are not ruled out. All noncommuting source access must be charged;unbounded instantaneous measurement/control is excluded by the premises. Bell-input success can be state-dependent. The qutrit attaining exchange needs additional source transition access that an immutable longitudinal measurement port does not supply. Fixed startup slew is not hard spectral bandwidth. Actual bare-source hidden Z noise is required: cavity photon loss with jump a cannot simply be relabeled Z. New qutrit construction has analytic proof but no claimed executed numerical validation;moderate-bandwidth companion points are numerical,not interval-certified or experimental. Local initialization,flags,calibration,storage,extra noise and success-scaled instrument errors remain separate costs.
